***
Adverting to the above cited reference, I submit that the enclosure in a petition
addressed to the D.I.G., VR, VSP and copy marked to the Passport Office, Visakhapatnam
and the respected officer, put in by one S.V.R. Murthy with allegations against one Kathila
Venkata laxmi, D/o Pydayya, weight lifter, Konda Velagada village of Nellimarla mandal
who allegedly cheated the Government by showing false Date of Birth (D.O.B.) Certificate.
Hence, the petitioner requested the officer to take necessary action against the respondent.

As per the instructions of the officer, I got verified the contents of the petition by the
concerned SB Zonal Staff and during field enquiries it was revealed that the actual Date of
Birth of the alleged respondent is 20-05-1992 as per the academic records, but, she obtained
Passport on 10-11-2010 with the false D.O.B. as 20-05-1993 and participated in the weight
lifting competitions. Later she again applied for the passport (Re-Issue enquiry) on 06-08-
2015 with modification of D.Q.B. by paying penalty amount of Rs. 5000/-. Accordingly, the
Passport authorities re-issued the Passport with actual D.O.B. as 20-05-1992.
